```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

library(clusterProfiler)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# Repo-relative paths: inputs from imports_stable/, outputs to analysis_outs/<module>/
repo_dir <- (function(d = normalizePath(getwd())) {
  while (!dir.exists(file.path(d, "imports_stable"))) {
    if (dirname(d) == d) stop("Could not find repo root (folder containing imports_stable/)")
    d <- dirname(d)
  }
  d
})()
imports_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "imports_stable")
outs_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "analysis_outs", "05_in_vitro_differentiation_RNAseq_SIG18")
dir.create(file.path(outs_dir, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(outs_dir, "spca"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
source(file.path(repo_dir, "functions/r_custom/plotting_fxns.R"))
source(file.path(repo_dir, "functions/r_custom/scRNA_seq_analysis_functions.R"))
theme_set(theme_Publication())
interaction_palette <- c("#808080",brewer.pal(5,"Dark2"))
names(interaction_palette) <- c("none", "additive over saturation", "buffering", 
                      "buffering complete", "synergy negative", "synergy positive")
```

# Goal

-   GO enrichment for sPCA genes

# Import

```{r}
lm_scored <- read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG18/analysis_outs/spca/lm_scored_zscore_degs_alpha10.0_sPCA_clean.csv"))
spca_genes <- read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG18/analysis_outs/spca/zscore_degs_alpha10.0_sPCA_loadings.csv"))

# component order from the hierarchical clustering of the heatmap in
# 04_spca_pos_synergy_viz.Rmd, so ORA plots use the same component order
component_order <- read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG18/analysis_outs/spca/spca_alpha10.0_full_hm_row_order.csv")) %>%
  pull(component)
```

# Process Input Data

```{r}
# filter for clean components
df <- spca_genes %>%
  filter(spca_component %in% lm_scored$component)

# get mouse to human conversion
geneTable <- mouse_to_human_genes(unique(df$gene)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = MGI.symbol,
         gene_human = HGNC.symbol)

# join human gene to tibble
df <- df %>%
  left_join(geneTable, by="gene")

# Map Human Symbols to Human Entrez IDs
ids <- bitr(df$gene_human, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
df_merged <- inner_join(df, ids, by = c("gene_human" = "SYMBOL"))
```

# Go Enrichment

Here I will compare to the human datasets since they are generally more rich.

```{r}
# Get MsigDB Hallmark
hallmark_human <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
ids <- bitr(hallmark_human$ensembl_gene, fromType = "ENSEMBL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
hallmark_human <- hallmark_human %>%
  inner_join(ids, by=c("ensembl_gene"="ENSEMBL")) %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, ENTREZID)
```

```{r}
# kegg enrichment
res_kegg <- compareCluster(ENTREZID ~ spca_component, 
                           data = df_merged, 
                           fun = "enrichKEGG", 
                           organism = "hsa")

# hallmark enrichment
res_hallmark <- compareCluster(ENTREZID ~ spca_component, 
                               data = df_merged, 
                               fun = "enricher", 
                               TERM2GENE = hallmark_human)

```

```{r}
# function to extract tibble from results
get_enrich_tibble <- function(res_object, n_terms = 5) {
  res_object %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      # specific logic to convert "10/100" string to 0.1 numeric
      GeneRatio_Num = sapply(strsplit(GeneRatio, "/"), 
                             function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) / as.numeric(x[2]))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Description = fct_reorder(Description, GeneRatio_Num))
}

# get results
kegg_data <- get_enrich_tibble(res_kegg)
hallmark_data <- get_enrich_tibble(res_hallmark)

# order Cluster (spca_component) to match the hierarchical clustering of the
# heatmap in 04_spca_pos_synergy_viz.Rmd; components not in that clustering
# (e.g. filtered out as replicate-driven) are appended after in their original order
kegg_data <- kegg_data %>%
  mutate(Cluster = factor(as.character(Cluster), levels = component_order))
hallmark_data <- hallmark_data %>%
  mutate(Cluster = factor(as.character(Cluster), levels = component_order))

write_csv(kegg_data, file.path(outs_dir, "spca/zscore_degs_alpha10.0_sPCA_kegg.csv"))
write_csv(hallmark_data, file.path(outs_dir, "spca/zscore_degs_alpha10.0_sPCA_hallmark.csv"))
```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=14}
p1 <- hallmark_data %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Cluster, y = Description, color = GeneRatio_Num)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 0.5), oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  xlab("Gene Ratio") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 0.5
  ))

usefulCategories <- c("Cell growth and death","Signaling molecules and interaction","Immune system","Immune disease","Signal transduction")
p2 <- kegg_data %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.1) %>%
  filter(subcategory %in% usefulCategories) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Cluster, y = Description, color = GeneRatio_Num)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = -log10(p.adjust))) +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    xlab("Gene Ratio") +
    ylab(NULL) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5))
```

```{r, fig.height=16, fig.width=20}
p1+p2+plot_layout(ncol=1, heights = c(1.3, 2))
ggsave(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/SIG18_spca_go_enrichment.pdf"))
```
